contexts.text: A horse = Own intelligence.
Ephraim, here, = Own intelligence; that is, those who believe and want themselves to be wise not from the Lord.

When he does not suffer himself to be illuminated through the Word... but through Own intelligence, then his obscurity becomes dark; thus false; for the internal way is closed, and there is no influx and communication through Heaven.

He was troublesome to them, because he wanted to rule them from his own intelligence... I spoke to him about intelligence from proprium, saying that in the Christian world it prevails so greatly that it is believed that all intelligence is thence... The sphere of his intelligence infested me; but, as he was in the persuasion that he was more intelligent than others, he would not go away. He was then shown by the Angels what the quality of intelligence from proprium is, and what that of intelligence from the Divine; and this by lights. Described.
This is induced by human erudition with those who trust in their own intelligence.
Thou shalt not make unto thee a graven image = not from Own intelligence; (for) a graven image = that which is not from the Lord, but from the proprium of man...
In the things which are hatched from Own intelligence there is nothing of spiritual life. Signified.
The art of hatching by reasonings from Own intelligence. Treated of.
For within all things which go forth from Own intelligence there are no truths and goods, but falsities and evils. Signified, Explained.
By reasonings from Own intelligence.

Thou shalt not build them hewn = not from Own intelligence; (for) hewn stones = such things as are from Own intelligence. Explained... For the things hatched from proprium, or from Own intelligence, have life from man... AE 391:21.
The things from proprium, or from Own intelligence, are called truths, but are not truths; they only appear as truths in the external form... but in the internal form are falsities.
There are two religiosities in the world which are from Own intelligence. Explained.
The figments from Own intelligence...
By hewn stone is signified that which is from Own intelligence in the following passages. Illustrated.
That religion is to be formed from truths from the Lord... and not from Own intelligence. Signified.

A religiosity which is hatched from Own intelligence, and not from the Word, is meant by idols, strange gods, molten images, and graven images; for the things from proprium are nothing else, being in themselves dead; and yet they are adored as if they were alive.
By these instruments are signified such things as are of Own intelligence...
For that which is from Own intelligence is in itself devoid of life; nay, is spiritually dead; for the proprium of man is nothing but evil.
(Thus) from the things of the Word comes forth worship truly Divine; and by no means from those of Own intelligence. Signified.
It is believed that from the lumen of nature, thus without revelation, man can know many things which belong to religion... and yet these are the things which are from Own intelligence...
Hence was evident the quality of the lumen of nature without revelation; consequently the quality of that which is from Own intelligence.
Diviners, augurs, sorcerers = those who destroy the truths and goods of the Church... from Own intelligence, etc.
Under Idol, see this reference. AC 9424:7.
Worship from Own intelligence. Signified.
Those who are in... the persuasion of intelligence and wisdom from self, are in such... thick darkness.
Those who trust in their own intelligence. Signified.

Faculties, here, = all things which are from Own intelligence... and therefore to deny all one's faculties is to attribute nothing of intelligence and wisdom to self. He who does not do this cannot be instructed by the Lord. Signified.
To prepare food = to teach self from own intelligence.

Formed it with a graving tool = from own intelligence; (thus) to prepare false doctrine from own intelligence, which is done by the application of the sense of the letter... to favour the loves of self and of the world; for when these loves reign, the man is not in any illustration from Heaven, but takes all things from Own intelligence, and confirms them from the sense of the letter... Explained.
An artificer = the man who forms it from Own intelligence.
How false doctrinals are formed so as to cohere... from Own intelligence, under the leadership of pleasure, cupidity, and love. Signified.
A graven thing, here, = what is from Own intelligence... for it is said, Every man is made a fool by knowledge... Here knowledge = Own intelligence...

As the falsities and evils of doctrine which are signified by graven and molten things are fabricated by man's own intelligence under the leadership of his love, they are called the work of man's hands, etc. Illustrated.
Under Intelligence, see this reference.

It is implanted in every man... to think of God under a human form... but this has been extinguished by all who through Own intelligence have removed the influx from Heaven: (such) want to have an invisible God.
Those who had been in the conceit of Own intelligence were seen black.
Abaddon or Apollyon = that their falsities were from the Hell where they are merely natural, and in Own intelligence.
The proprium of man is the love of self, and the derivative conceit of Own intelligence.

After death, those who ascribe all things to Own intelligence... first become like drunkards; afterwards like fools; and finally stupid, and they sit in darkness. Beware, therefore, of such a delirium. TCR 276:end.
Thus is described Own intelligence. Treated of.
The other religiosity, which falsifies the truths of the Church, originates from the conceit of Own intelligence... (and) is meant by Philistia.
Goliath smitten by David, represented their conceit of Own intelligence.
From the root of the serpent went forth a basilisk = from the conceit of Own intelligence the destruction of all truth with them.
It is the number of a man = the quality of Own intelligence.
The horn between his eyes = Own intelligence.
The great horn of the he-goat broken = no appearance of Own intelligence.

If the understanding (of an evil man) sees truths opposed to... the principles of his own intelligence, he either falsifies them, or passes them by... or retains them in the memory to serve as means to his life's love, or to the conceit of his own intelligence.
They had no faith... (and were such) as had been in Own intelligence.
Therefore, if man's life's love is the love of self, he comes into the conceit of Own intelligence...
When the love of self inspires its consort the understanding with its own love, this in the consort becomes conceit, which is the conceit of Own intelligence. Hence is Own prudence.

Therefore the concupiscences of evil... the perceptions of the concupiscences... and the delights of the concupiscences... and their thoughts... are actuated by the love of self through the conceit of Own intelligence.
Those who are in faith separated from charity are in Own intelligence...

That the evil cannot be completely withdrawn from evils by the Lord, and be led into goods, so long as they believe Own intelligence to be everything, and the Divine Providence not anything. General article.
That Own intelligence, when the will is in evil, sees nothing but falsity. Explained.
From Own intelligence he believes himself to be a deity...
That if Own intelligence sees truth then, it either averts itself, or it falsities it. Explained.
Own intelligence can induce the human form in externals only; but the Divine Providence in internals...

Intelligence appears to be his own with both a good man and an evil one; and moreover a good man is equally bound to act from intelligence as if his own... but he who believes in the Divine Providence is withdrawn from evil; whereas he who does not believe in it, is not withdrawn... The difference between these two intelligences. (Explained.)
The imaginations of falsity are from Own intelligence.
The quality of those who are infatuated from Own intelligence. Described.
The proprium of his understanding is the conceit of Own intelligence...
Through his rationality he comes into the conceit of Own intelligence. Signified.
The vessels of a potter = the things of Own intelligence, which are all false, and, in themselves, of no account.
The Satanic kingdom consists of those who are in the love of dominating from the conceit of Own intelligence, and are thence in insanity...
The appearance of Own intelligence from conceit which originates from infernal love. Signified, Explained.
All Own intelligence burns from conceit; and its conceit arises from infernal love.
The infernal falsity from which is their own intelligence, through which all the truths of the Word have been falsified. Signified, Explained.
Their imaginary and visionary argumentations from infernal love and Own intelligence. Signified, Explained.
The Church which through reasonings from Own intelligence had falsified the truths of the Word. Signified.
That in their thoughts and discourses, interiorly regarded, there is nothing else... than... the conceit of Own intelligence which is the proprium of the understanding, etc. Signified, Explained.
Smoke = the conceit of Own intelligence, which is the proprium of man's understanding, going forth from the love of self and of the world like smoke from fire.
Sulphur = the concupiscences from infernal love flowing forth through the conceit of Own intelligence. Illustrated. AR 636.
Egypt = ... the love of reigning from the conceit of Own intelligence, which is in (that) Church.
The doctrine of the Church not from the Word, but hatched from Own intelligence. Signified, Explained.
Under Head, see this reference.
By the work of an artificer, in the opposite sense, is signified that work which is done from Own intelligence, from which nothing else can be produced than what is false. Illustrated.
That they were rejected by those who are in falsities from Own intelligence. Signified, Explained.
To give gratis = from the Lord, and not from any intelligence proper to man.

That the men of the New Church will not be in the love of self and in Own intelligence, and thence in merely natural lumen; but in spiritual light from the Divine truth of the Word from the Lord alone. Signified, Explained.
The sun and moon = the love of self, and Own intelligence.
That in the New Jerusalem... men will not be in Knowledges about God from the natural lumen which is from Own intelligence... Signified, Explained.

This love (of wisdom), if it remains with the man... is called the conceit or love of Own intelligence; (but) this love was taken out of the man, lest it should destroy him, and was transcribed into the woman, in order to become conjugial love... CL 353.
Hence no one can ever love his consort truly conjugially who is in the conceit of Own intelligence from the love of self.
Husbands grow cold when they are in conceit from own intelligence.
Hence atheists who are in the glory of reputation from the love of self, and thence in the conceit of own intelligence, enjoy a more lofty rationality...
Whether a man who loves himself from his own intelligence can love his wife. (Continued. See Intelligence.)

Therefore the wife continually attracts to herself her husband's conceit of Own intelligence, and extinguishes it with him, and vivifies it with herself, and thus turns it into conjugial love, and infills it with pleasantnesses beyond measure. This has been provided by the Lord, lest the conceit of Own intelligence should so infatuate the man that he would believe himself to be intelligent and wise from himself, and not from the Lord, and would thus want to eat of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, and so believe himself to be like God... as the serpent said and persuaded...

The two priests and the ambassador all believed at heart that intelligence and wisdom and the derivative prudence are from man, because they are in man... But the priests... said. There is nothing of (them) from man... It was then said to the ambassador, Put on the garments of a priest (and) he then declared that nothing of (them) can ever be possible except from God... The voice from Heaven then said to the two priests, Put off your own garments, and put on those of political ministers... They then thought from their interior selves, and spoke from arguments which they had inwardly cherished in favour of Own intelligence... At that moment there appeared a tree... and they were told. It is the tree of the knowledge of good and evil; beware lest you eat of it. Yet those three, infatuated with Own intelligence, burned with the cupidity of eating of it; and said to each other, Why not? Is not the fruit good? and they went to it, and ate. Instantly then, those three, because they were in like faith, became bosom friends; and entered together into the way of Own intelligence which tended into Hell...

Everyone who does not read the Word under the Lord's auspices, reads it under the auspices of Own intelligence; and this is like an owl in such things as are in spiritual light... In a word, to read the Word under the auspices of Own intelligence, which is done by all who do not acknowledge the Lord as the God of Heaven and earth, and thence does not approach and worship Him alone, may be likened to...
The man who... reads the Word under the auspices of Own intelligence, believes himself to be lynx-eyed... yet inwardly does not see a whit of truth...

Those who believe themselves to be able, from Own intelligence, to procure for themselves Knowledges about God, Heaven and Hell, and the spiritual things of the Church, do not know that, regarded in himself, the natural man is against the spiritual... They may be likened to... Their lot after death.
How dangerous it is to enter intellectually into the dogmas of faith which have been manufactured from Own intelligence, and thence from falsities...
Have made for themselves a morning light from Own intelligence, and an evening light from the Word.

The reason these preachers were deprived of the priesthood, was that they did not fashion their sermons from the Word... but from their own rational lumen... selecting something savoury from their own intelligence...
Concerning those who are in Own intelligence. SE 4909.

At this day a host of people... do not believe that anything inflows from Heaven... but that such things come forth from Own intelligence, saying that everyone is the builder of his own future. The reason ex.
Opulence and dignity do also come to those who act from Own intelligence; but to them these things are not a blessing, but a curse...

Those who have entirely believed themselves to owe all things to Own intelligence, appear to sit at a table, and to write there... They have a hat down to the eyes, under which, as it were, they think. They are most malicious, and are sent away to that infernal den where is Charles XII.

As to seek eagerly for honours and riches, and to acquire them, from Own intelligence, is an abuse of the laws of order in the natural world, thus also an abuse of the rational things of the mind therefore those of them who by arts... bring themselves to it, in the other life become magicians...

There was a Spirit with me who was in Own intelligence and wisdom, and on that account was such that he believed he knew and saw all things, and therefore also ruled all things. (Continued at AC 4419, above.)
Graven images, and idols = the falsities which are from Own intelligence.
The vessels of the potter = such things in the natural man as are from Own intelligence...
Those who think from Own intelligence, think from the world. Explained.
As these loves belong to man's proprium, the things which man sees and perceives from them are from Own intelligence.

These are they who do not think from Own intelligence when they read the Word. The chief cause (of this) is that their interior mind looks to the Lord, and the Lord elevates it to Himself, and the lower mind at the same time, and thus withdraws it from the proprium of man, which cannot be done with those who principally regard themselves and the world.
(Thus) man from Own intelligence perceives nothing but evils, and sees nothing but falsities.
A figment is that which is from man's Own intelligence.
Those who are insane in spiritual things from believing that they are intelligent from themselves. Tr... The glorying of the intelligence or erudition thence is meant by the crown of pride.
Those who make for themselves doctrinal things from Own intelligence, and not from the Lord. Treated of.
Those who, from Own intelligence, want to acquire love and faith. Treated of.
Own intelligence, which confirms falsities and evils by reasonings from scientifics, and by applications of the sense of the letter. Treated of.
Glorying from Own intelligence. Signified.
The Judgment upon those who, from Own intelligence, believe themselves wise in Divine things. Treated of.
That they are from Own intelligence, is signified by, which your own hands have made for you.
The elations of man = the conceit of Own intelligence.
Burning coals = the conceit of Own intelligence; fire, the love of self.
Said to be set on fire from the conceit of Own intelligence, whence are falsities.
A great mountain burning with fire = the love of self and the derivative Own intelligence... For all Own intelligence is from the love of self.
Thus are the truths of the Word falsified by all those who are in the conceit of Own intelligence from the love of self. Explained.

Broken pits which hold no water = to hatch from own intelligence doctrinal things, which, because they are from proprium, are false; for the proprium of man is nothing but evil; and, because it is evil, falsity is produced from it.

Idols of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of stone, and of wood = false doctrinal things, which are from Own intelligence, favouring the loves of the body and the world, and the principles taken up thence. Explained, Illustrated.
See Idol. AE 587:3.
That there is not any spiritual life in... the things of Own intelligence. Signified.
By this whole description of a graven image is meant the formation of doctrine from Own intelligence. (Explained in detail.)

Buy wine and milk without silver, and without price = that Divine truth spiritual and Divine truth natural are to be procured without Own intelligence... By silver is here signified truth from proprium, or Own intelligence; in like manner by labour.
The confidence of Own intelligence. Treated of. AE 627:12.
The loss and dissipation of the affections of good through the conceit of Own intelligence. Signified.

The reason these Hells are more malignant than the rest, is that in proportion as man is in the love of self, and at the same time in the love of Own intelligence, his natural lumen is in a certain quasi splendour; for the love of self is like a fire, which kindles this lumen. Hence it is that they can think and reason cleverly against the Divine, and against all things of Heaven and the Church.
The falsities of the thoughts, and the evils of the cupidities, which he had because he was elated in height, that is, because he was proud from the love of Own intelligence. Signified.
Saying in her heart, I and none besides me = the falsity of Own intelligence.

As the falsities which flow forth from the evils of the love of self are attended with conceit, for the man then thinks from the proprium, therefore by Egypt is here signified the conceit of Own intelligence. (See Egypt and at AE 654:43. AE 654:48.)
The conceit of Own intelligence from knowledge. Signified.
The sons of man = those in Own intelligence.
No longer any understanding of truth, or perception of the Knowledges of good, on account of the conceit of Own intelligence. Signified.
The state of those who want to be wise from themselves, thus from Own intelligence, in the things of Heaven and the Church. Treated of.
The destruction of (the truths and goods of the Church) through the conceit of Own intelligence. Signified.
Own intelligence and its falsities endeavouring to destroy the truths of the Church. Signified.
The natural man deprived of all truth and good through conceit from knowledge and thence from Own intelligence. Treated of.
By the river is signified Own intelligence.
These words involve the conceit of Own intelligence.
The pride of Israel = the conceit of Own intelligence in such things as are of the Church.
That there will be no faculty to resist evils from Own intelligence. Signified.
Those who from Own intelligence have hatched for themselves dogmas from the Word, constitute the body of the dragon. AE 714:10, Explained.

All who study the Word, and are in the love of self, are also in the conceit of Own intelligence; and all who are in this conceit, and at the same time excel in cleverness from natural lumen, hatch for themselves Word. This is the origin of all all the Falsities, in the Christian dogmas from the the heresies, and world.

Intelligence from proprium is from self; but intelligence not from proprium is from the Lord. All those have intelligence from proprium who are in the love of self; for the love of self is the very proprium of man; and those are in the love of self who read the Word and collect dogmas thence for the sake of reputation, glory, and honours...

The conceit of Own intelligence is with all who confirm falsities even to the destruction of Divine truth... For those are in this conceit who regard themselves alone... in their writings and preachings; for they are in the love of self; and everyone who is in the love of self is in conceit while he is writing and preaching; and conceit derives all things from man's proprium. Hence it is that it is called the conceit of Own intelligence. The love of self resides in the will, and the conceit of Own intelligence in the derivative thought. These, therefore, while they are thinking anything from themselves, cannot think anything but falsities...
Own intelligence. Described. (in the Word.)
They who read the Word without doctrine... and are at the same time in the conceit of Own intelligence thence, produce adultery as of a father with his daughter-in-law.
Redemption. 1. 10. Intelligence from proprium one of the causes why falsities flow into the primates of the Church, and flow forth from them.
